subject.title: macOS launchd: plugin/config maintenance can leave Control UI in broken partial-reload state; restart may require doctor --fix

question: What temporary degraded-state contract should Gateway expose to Control UI and `sessions.resolve` while plugin/config reload or restart deferral makes the runtime only partially trustworthy?
rationale: The source shows several partial mechanisms, but choosing whether to gate session RPCs, expose `reloading`/`restart_deferred` states, or split the WebChat notice fix from broader launchd recovery changes is a product and compatibility decision.

options.title: Add shared degraded-state gate
options.body: Make Gateway publish a retryable degraded/reloading state for session RPCs and Control UI until the session graph and plugin set are trustworthy, then prove macOS launchd recovery without `doctor --fix`.

options.title: Land only the WebChat subset first
options.body: Treat PR #95154 as the narrow no-notice fix for #95141 and keep this issue open for a separate launchd readiness/recovery design.

options.title: Close as operator-maintenance misuse
options.body: Document live plugin/config maintenance as unsupported and keep current readiness/restart behavior, accepting that operators may see misleading partial-liveness failures.

recommendation.title: Add shared degraded-state gate
recommendation.body: Make Gateway publish a retryable degraded/reloading state for session RPCs and Control UI until the session graph and plugin set are trustworthy, then prove macOS launchd recovery without `doctor --fix`.

likelyOwner.reason: The history trail connects this owner to Gateway startup sidecars, hot reload isolation, and method/runtime behavior across the central surfaces.
